title: Become Organic Salon

Feel beautiful inside and out:

  • Organic, plant-based ammonia-free hair color
  • Located on a 55-acre tropical wellness retreat
  • Sustainable, toxin-free products & treatments

Pamper yourself at our vegan, organic on-campus store & salon

BECOME is the ultimate clean, green beauty experience, located on the globally-renowned 55-acre Hippocrates Wellness tropical retreat, a world leader in health and wellbeing for nearly 70 years. Whether for hair, nails, makeup, a pampering facial treatment, or laser hair removal, our expert team will ensure you leave our salon looking and feeling your best self. Our premium, organic BECOME range is formulated upon a natural, plant-based foundation of algae and seaweed extracts, power-packed with vitamins, antioxidants, and minerals for radiant health and beauty without harm to you or the planet. Our salon welcomes everyone, and you don’t have to be a guest at Hippocrates to book! Try something new today and call us for your ultimate, nature-fuelled beauty experience.
Call now to book your rejuvenation treatment >

Discover more about our cruelty-free treatments & products

Hair

Nourish and hydrate your hair with our ammonia and chemical-free treatments to achieve maximum body and shine. Try our signature wheatgrass scalp treatment to strengthen and replenish your hair with the highest quality organic ingredients available.

Nails

Revitalize and love your nails with our organic mineral-color nail polish range. You can trust that our products are free from Toluene, Formaldehyde, DBP, and TPH.

Aesthetic treatments

Sculpt your body with our non-invasive, cellulite-busting JuVaShape therapy. Experience our advanced laser hair removal or pamper yourself with a skin-boosting facial and nature-based makeup range.

We are free from

  • Mineral oils
  • Parabens
  • Sulfates
  • Artificial fragrances or colors
  • Animal products
  • Animal testing
